note: Uniform scale + translation carrying Z-Anatomy (after rotating Z-up to Y-up: x, z, -y) into the atlas body space of each body. Fitted by least squares over vertebra, sacrum, hip bone, hyoid and laryngeal cartilage bounding boxes present in both Z-Anatomy and the HRA united body (scripts/assets/extract, work/fit2.py in the build log). Residual is about 10 mm vertically and 15-20 mm antero-posteriorly; the female fit reuses the male-derived Z-Anatomy skeleton scaled to the female HRA vertebral column, and is flagged as such in the interface.
